The acceptance test did not compile: it built a PromptBuilder from
baseSystemPrompt/systemPromptSuffix/contextConfig, none of which exist on
PromptBuilderConfig, whose required field is identity. It also asserted
with three expects against the re-lint max of one.

Both are repaired in the shape chatOrchestrator.test.ts already uses: the
prompt builder is built from identity, and the rejection is read as a
value through outcomeOf so one expect asserts {outcome, caughtError,
afterSessionRan} together. The assertions are unchanged in substance: the
caller still sees the original error, onError receives that same error
object, afterSession still runs. The spec's validated-by anchor moves
with the test title to line 36.
